description: This Dart file defines a Flutter controller class 'HomeController' responsible for managing the state and data fetching logic of a home feed screen in an OTT frontend application. It handles fetching the home feed payload, managing continue watching items, and listens to cache updates from a content repository.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the home feed state, including loading data, handling cache updates, and providing continue watching items.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed payload asynchronously, updates the state, and initiates loading of continue watching items.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads the list of recently watched content items for the continue watching section, with a limit defaulting to 10.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes the continue watching list after playback progress has been persisted to storage.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the home feed and continue watching list based on cache updates.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes cache listener and disposes of the controller.
